choice_prompt:5:1411403001.source_cn: ……如、如今人类帝国的投资商，商务考察的时候都是这么声势浩大的吗？！

say:6:1411403002:1.text: I mean, General Hogan and Evie came by ship, horse, or carriage like normal folks!
say:6:1411403002:1.source_cn: 对、对嘛，我就说，霍根将军和伊芙他们都是老老实实坐船、...

say:6:1411403002:1.female: I mean, General Hogan and Evie came by ship, horse, or carriage like normal folks!

choice_prompt:7:1411403002.male: I mean, General Hogan and Evie came by ship, horse, or carriage like normal folks!
choice_prompt:7:1411403002.female: I mean, General Hogan and Evie came by ship, horse, or carriage like normal folks!

say:8:1411403003:1.text: What?! A Celestial investor?! Did I stumble into a fairy tale?
say:8:1411403003:1.source_cn: 什、什么？！什么时候投资商都有半神出马了？！
say:8:1411403003:1.male: What?! A Celestial investor?! Did I stumble into a fairy tale?
say:8:1411403003:1.female: What?! A Celestial investor?! Did I stumble into a fairy tale?

say:10:1411403007:1.text: Don't be so shocked, Zanie. Although I am a bit surprised myself...
say:10:1411403007:1.source_cn: 不要一惊一乍的呀，祖娅，虽然我也吓了一大跳……

say:11:1411403008:1.text: Remember, they're investors first! Let's put on our friendly faces!
say:11:1411403008:1.source_cn: 别忘了！这不仅仅是半神大人，不对，半神大人们！还是投资商呢！

say:12:1411403009:1.text: Apologies for my rudeness. I just didn't expect... Anyway, welcome! You must be Mister—no, wait—Lord... Archon Baelran? Your Holiness...?
say:12:1411403009:1.source_cn: 抱、抱歉，失礼了，我没想到……呃，您就是，巴赫朗先生…...

say:13:1411403010:1.text: So, hey, what do people usually call Celestials? Evie never taught me this.
say:13:1411403010:1.source_cn: 喂，你们一般怎么称呼半神啊？！伊芙没讲过这个！

say:15:1411403011:1.text: No, I should be the one apologizing.
say:15:1411403011:1.source_cn: 哪里，应该我这边道歉才对。

say:16:1411403012:1.text: I'm Baelran, and you must be Miss Zanie. Please, no need for pleasantries. You can just call me by my name.
say:16:1411403012:1.source_cn: 我就是巴赫朗，您是祖娅女士，对吧？请不用客气，不介意的...

say:17:1411403013:1.text: It's my fault for not planning properly. The ship I reserved was late, so I used my special way of traveling. I didn't mean to startle you all.
say:17:1411403013:1.source_cn: 这次是我没有做好计划，因为乘坐的船只有些迟了，所以用了...

say:19:1411403014:2.text: We couldn't find a nice carriage...
say:19:1411403014:2.source_cn: 明明是因为没有找到合适的豪华马车。

say:21:1411403015:1.text: ...or any pure white horses. And we didn't hire any attendants.
say:21:1411403015:1.source_cn: 也没有找到一样颜色的马，侍从们也没有安顿好。

say:22:1411403016:1.text: So he simply used magic to get here—typical Baelran, who enjoys the finer things in life.
say:22:1411403016:1.source_cn: 所以就干脆直接用魔法过来了，喜欢享受的巴赫朗。

say:23:1411403017:1.text: Might as well have flown over. Baelran does love to make a grand entrance.
say:23:1411403017:1.source_cn: 还不如直接飞过来呢，讲究排场的巴赫朗。

say:24:1411403018:1.text: Yes... These two are Elijah and Lailah. They're not here for business. They're my... friends.
say:24:1411403018:1.source_cn: ……呃，补充一句，前来商务考察的只有我，这两位是伊莱亚...

say:25:1411403019:1.text: Not really friends. More like acquaintances...

say:27:1411403021:1.text: In reality, I think he wanted to say "lackeys" or maybe "pests". Isn't that right, Baelran?
say:27:1411403021:1.source_cn: 其实你想说“跟班”“赶不走的跟屁虫”吧，巴赫朗。

say:28:1411403022:1.text: We didn't want to come either, especially with Merlin here. It's all Baelran's fault.
say:28:1411403022:1.source_cn: 我们也不想来的，尤其是梅林还在这里，都怪你，巴赫朗。
say:28:1411403022:1.male: We didn't want to come either, especially with Merlin here. It's all Baelran's fault.
say:28:1411403022:1.female: We didn't want to come either, especially with Merlin here. It's all Baelran's fault.

choice_prompt:29:1411403022.text: We didn't want to come either, especially with Merlin here. It's all Baelran's fault.
choice_prompt:29:1411403022.source_cn: 我们也不想来的，尤其是梅林还在这里，都怪你，巴赫朗。
choice_prompt:29:1411403022.male: We didn't want to come either, especially with Merlin here. It's all Baelran's fault.
choice_prompt:29:1411403022.female: We didn't want to come either, especially with Merlin here. It's all Baelran's fault.

say:30:1411403023:1.text: No, it really has little to do with you, my dear Merlin. I'm also aware of your amnesia...
say:30:1411403023:1.source_cn: 不，确实和你关系不大，亲爱的梅林，我已经听说你失忆的事了。
say:30:1411403023:1.male: No, it really has little to do with you, my dear Merlin. I'm also aware of your amnesia...
say:30:1411403023:1.female: No, it really has little to do with you, my dear Merlin. I'm also aware of your amnesia...

say:32:1411403025:1.text: So, Archon Baelran, Lailah, and Elijah all know the Magister?
say:32:1411403025:1.source_cn: 咦？所以，巴赫朗殿下，还有伊莱亚殿下和莱拉殿下，都认识...
say:32:1411403025:1.male: So, Archon Baelran, Lailah, and Elijah all know the Magister?
say:32:1411403025:1.female: So, Archon Baelran, Lailah, and Elijah all know the Magister?

say:33:1411403026:1.text: You don't need to use any titles for us. You're Hammie, right? A perfect little lady with a lot of magical power, I've heard.
say:33:1411403026:1.source_cn: 不用对我们用敬称，小使魔——我猜，你就是漫漫吧？一位有...

say:34:1411403027:1.text: Yes! I'm Hammie! Nice to meet you, Baelran.
say:34:1411403027:1.source_cn: ……啊、是的，我就是漫漫，很高兴认识您，巴赫朗！

say:36:1411403028:1.source_cn: 又来了，无时无刻不在散发魅力的巴赫朗。

say:37:1411403029:1.text: He looks friendly enough, but I'd trust him about as far as I'd trust Dionel in a room full of other people's spouses.
say:37:1411403029:1.source_cn: 对任何人都一副友善模样，但比萨基塔里斯还不值得信任的巴赫朗。

choice_prompt:38:1411403029.text: He looks friendly enough, but I'd trust him about as far as I'd trust Dionel in a room full of other people's spouses.
choice_prompt:38:1411403029.source_cn: 对任何人都一副友善模样，但比萨基塔里斯还不值得信任的巴赫朗。

say:39:1411403030:1.text: Well, Baelran abandoned his duty as a Celestial to walk in this mortal world as a merchant.
say:39:1411403030:1.source_cn: 巴赫朗抛弃了他作为半神的本职，而在这世间以商人的身份行走。
say:39:1411403030:1.male: Well, Baelran abandoned his duty as a Celestial to walk in this mortal world as a merchant.
say:39:1411403030:1.female: Well, Baelran abandoned his duty as a Celestial to walk in this mortal world as a merchant.

say:40:1411403031:1.text: Elijah and I are here to try and correct this prodigal son.
say:40:1411403031:1.source_cn: 而我和伊莱亚只是为他而来，试图将走偏的行星纠正回原本的轨道。
say:40:1411403031:1.male: Elijah and I are here to try and correct this prodigal son.
say:40:1411403031:1.female: Elijah and I are here to try and correct this prodigal son.

say:42:1411403034:1.text: Everyone's a critic. Don't worry about these two.
say:42:1411403034:1.source_cn: 正如他们俩所说，诸位，不用在意，他们只会时时刻刻地批评...

say:43:1411403035:1.text: We've wasted enough time. Why don't we get to the point? What do you think, Miss Zanie?
say:43:1411403035:1.source_cn: 现在，也耽误了不少时间，我们尽快开始正题吧，你觉得呢，...

say:44:1411403036:1.text: You can just call me Zanie.
say:44:1411403036:1.source_cn: 啊，你也叫我祖娅就好，不用这么客气！

say:45:1411403037:1.text: So, Baelran, which aspect of our operations are you interested in? Our ores and minerals? Our assembly line or design schematics?
say:45:1411403037:1.source_cn: 所以，巴赫朗你这次是对哪方面有兴趣？矿物？材料？还是新...

choice_prompt:46:1411403037.text: So, Baelran, which aspect of our operations are you interested in? Our ores and minerals? Our assembly line or design schematics?
choice_prompt:46:1411403037.source_cn: 所以，巴赫朗你这次是对哪方面有兴趣？矿物？材料？还是新的铸造流水线和设计方案？

say:47:1411403038:1.text: Yeah, I memorized all the lines Evie gave me, but in the end, I figured I'd just be myself.
say:47:1411403038:1.source_cn: 是啊，我背了半天伊芙给我的套话，但我心想，总应付不了一辈子。
say:47:1411403038:1.male: Yeah, I memorized all the lines Evie gave me, but in the end, I figured I'd just be myself.
say:47:1411403038:1.female: Yeah, I memorized all the lines Evie gave me, but in the end, I figured I'd just be myself.

say:48:1411403039:1.text: Whether it be Celestials or grand merchants, it's better to show them what we dwarves are really like. That way, it's easier for them to get used to it.
say:48:1411403039:1.source_cn: 半神也好大商人也罢，我们矮人就是这个样子，让他们习惯习...
say:48:1411403039:1.male: Whether it be Celestials or grand merchants, it's better to show them what we dwarves are really like. That way, it's easier for them to get used to it.
say:48:1411403039:1.female: Whether it be Celestials or grand merchants, it's better to show them what we dwarves are really like. That way, it's easier for them to get used to it.

say:49:1411403040:1.text: Yes, straightforward relationships are the best and most trustworthy. Give me plain talk over flattery any day. At least then you know where you stand.
say:49:1411403040:1.source_cn: 正是如此，能像这样直截了当地建立关系，比起虚与委蛇的谈...

say:50:1411403041:1.text: I'm glad we're on the same page. I've no doubt that our cooperation will go smoothly.
say:50:1411403041:1.source_cn: 很高兴能与祖娅你心有灵犀，我相信，我们的合作一定会非常顺利。

choice_prompt:51:1411403041.text: I'm glad we're on the same page. I've no doubt that our cooperation will go smoothly.
choice_prompt:51:1411403041.source_cn: 很高兴能与祖娅你心有灵犀，我相信，我们的合作一定会非常顺利。

say:52:1411403042:1.text: What? This is how normal business negotiations go.
say:52:1411403042:1.source_cn: 呃？又怎么了，我这是正常的商务谈判开头！
say:52:1411403042:1.male: What? This is how normal business negotiations go.
say:52:1411403042:1.female: What? This is how normal business negotiations go.

say:54:1411403043:1.text: Perhaps your courtly manners and silver tongue could easily lead to misunderstandings.
say:54:1411403043:1.source_cn: 大概是你的绅士风度和用词很容易让人产生误会吧。

say:55:1411403044:1.source_cn: 唉，那么，我们该从哪儿开始呢，祖娅？

say:57:1411403045:1.text: Evie must have introduced our situation to you. How about we check things off one by one?
say:57:1411403045:1.source_cn: 我想，伊芙应该把我们的情况给你介绍过。我建议，我们按顺...

say:58:1411403046:1.text: We've launched a new partnership model and a unique standard for selecting new ores—one-of-a-kind in all of Esperia.
say:58:1411403046:1.source_cn: 我们建立起了全新的合作模式，对新矿石的选用也采取了全新...

say:59:1411403047:1.text: Yes, that's what intrigued me about this venture. How about we go see the mines?
say:59:1411403047:1.source_cn: 这正是我最有兴趣的部分。那，我们去看看矿洞怎么样？

say:60:1411403048:1.text: I've heard that the new alloys and metals you provide here require additional processing. I'm concerned about the production capacity of the raw materials.
say:60:1411403048:1.source_cn: 我已经听说你们这里提供的新合金需要额外加工，但我仍然很...

say:61:1411403049:0.text: Yes, please follow me. We've already optimized the routes for mining and transportation.
say:61:1411403049:0.source_cn: 当然可以，请跟我来，我们已经再次优化了采矿和运输的管理路线。

choice:51:0:1.text: The twins are staring at you.
choice:51:0:1.male: The twins are staring at you.
choice:51:0:1.female: The twins are staring at you.

say:63:1411403032:1.source_cn: 巴赫朗是来做他所谓的商务考察的。

say:64:1411403033:1.text: Elijah and I are trying to guide him back to his Celestial duties.
say:64:1411403033:1.source_cn: 而我与伊莱亚是来纠偏他走错的轨道，试图让他回归自己半神...
say:64:1411403033:1.male: Elijah and I are trying to guide him back to his Celestial duties.
say:64:1411403033:1.female: Elijah and I are trying to guide him back to his Celestial duties.

say:65:1411403024:1.text: I didn't expect you to be here, my dear Merlin. I didn't want to disturb you after you lost your memory...
say:65:1411403024:1.source_cn: 呃，是的，我没想到你居然也在，亲爱的梅林，我知道你失忆...
say:65:1411403024:1.male: I didn't expect you to be here, my dear Merlin. I didn't want to disturb you after you lost your memory...
say:65:1411403024:1.female: I didn't expect you to be here, my dear Merlin. I didn't want to disturb you after you lost your memory...

say:66:1411403004:1.text: What? Is this a trick? I always heard mages had a terrible sense of humor.
say:66:1411403004:1.source_cn: 啊？等会儿，你说什么？这不是你们魔法师的把戏吗？
say:66:1411403004:1.male: What? Is this a trick? I always heard mages had a terrible sense of humor.
say:66:1411403004:1.female: What? Is this a trick? I always heard mages had a terrible sense of humor.

choice_prompt:67:1411403004.male: What? Is this a trick? I always heard mages had a terrible sense of humor.
choice_prompt:67:1411403004.female: What? Is this a trick? I always heard mages had a terrible sense of humor.

say:68:1411403005:1.text: Wait—the two kids with him are Celestials too?!
say:68:1411403005:1.source_cn: 你是说，不光前头这个，连后头那俩小孩子也是？！
say:68:1411403005:1.male: Wait—the two kids with him are Celestials too?!
say:68:1411403005:1.female: Wait—the two kids with him are Celestials too?!

say:69:1411403006:1.text: Well, I guess I can't talk, looking as young as I do.
say:69:1411403006:1.source_cn: 呃，虽然我自己这长相也没什么资格说人家……
say:69:1411403006:1.male: Well, I guess I can't talk, looking as young as I do.
say:69:1411403006:1.female: Well, I guess I can't talk, looking as young as I do.

narration:70:14014013:0.text: A bunch of "investors" literally fell from the sky!
narration:70:14014013:0.source_cn: “投资商”一行人居然从天而降！
